events.continuity_hook: Refer to the confirmed Thursday arrival, three-night downtown stay, Sunday 11:30 a.m. appointment finish, stored suitcase, and selected later return flight.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm post-checkout luggage handling, calculate the convention-site-to-hotel-to-airport sequence, and prepare a concise final itinerary for the office file.
events.scenario_brief: The six-block downtown hotel has been booked for Thursday through Sunday, but its confirmation shows a noon checkout while Elena's final appointment ends at 11:30 a.m. at the convention site. Her later Sunday flight still provides enough airport time only if the hotel will hold her suitcase after checkout and she can retrieve it promptly before taking the train to the airport.

events.continuity_hook: Open a new solo professional trip with a Monday evening commitment, full Tuesday schedule, Wednesday 4:00 p.m. finish, and two hotel nights.
events.interaction_goal: Build several complete flight-and-hotel combinations, comparing Monday arrival margins, two-night totals, ground transportation, and realistic Wednesday airport timing.
events.scenario_brief: Elena has been asked to attend a two-day rights workshop in Atlanta. A hosted dinner begins Monday at 6:30 p.m., sessions run from 8:30 a.m. Tuesday through 4:00 p.m. Wednesday, and she needs to be back in Denver that night if a workable nonstop is available. She must compare Monday flights, two-night lodging near the workshop venue, and Wednesday returns with enough time to leave the closing session and reach the airport.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the Monday 6:30 p.m. dinner, Wednesday 4:00 p.m. workshop finish, two-night stay, and venue area fixed while choosing the round trip.
events.interaction_goal: Compare full round-trip costs and usable time, estimate airport transfers in both directions, and choose flights that establish the exact hotel arrival and checkout plan.
events.scenario_brief: The Atlanta outbound has narrowed to an earlier Monday nonstop that leaves ample time before dinner and a later lower-fare option that would require going directly from the airport to the restaurant. For Wednesday, the first nonstop after the workshop may be reachable only with an immediate departure at 4:00 p.m., while a later flight provides a better margin but reaches Denver close to midnight.

events.continuity_hook: Use the selected Monday and Wednesday flights, two-night stay, Monday dinner location, Tuesday morning start, and Wednesday airport plan.
events.interaction_goal: Calculate comparable two-night totals, assess walking and rail logistics, verify checkout and luggage storage, and identify the most practical room for office booking.
events.scenario_brief: With the earlier Monday outbound and later Wednesday return selected, Elena needs a room for two nights. The workshop hotel offers the easiest early start but has the highest total, a nearby business hotel costs less but requires crossing a large arterial road on foot, and a property by a rail station has straightforward airport access but is farther from the hosted dinner. Their taxes, cancellation deadlines, and Wednesday luggage-holding arrangements differ.

events.continuity_hook: Refer to the confirmed earlier Monday flight, two-night workshop hotel, revised 6:00 p.m. dinner location, and scheduled airport arrival.
events.interaction_goal: Recalculate the airport-to-dinner timeline, compare a hotel stop with direct travel, verify whether the restaurant or hotel can handle luggage, and settle the Monday arrival sequence.
events.scenario_brief: The flights and workshop hotel are confirmed, but the hosted dinner has moved to a restaurant in another neighborhood and now begins at 6:00 p.m. Elena's earlier flight still lands with a reasonable margin, although checking in at the hotel first may no longer be practical if traffic is heavy. She needs a plan for carrying or leaving her suitcase and reaching the new location on time.

events.continuity_hook: Open a separate shared trip for two adults, one room ending Monday, a fixed Saturday evening performance, and otherwise flexible daytime plans.
events.interaction_goal: Develop several complete flight-and-hotel combinations for both departure-day options, comparing total cost, usable leisure time, neighborhood access, and transportation to the Saturday performance.
events.scenario_brief: Elena and her spouse are considering a four-night leisure trip to San Diego around a Saturday evening theater performance for which they already have tickets. They can travel on Thursday or Friday, want daytime flexibility for the waterfront and museums, and need one shared room through Monday. They are comparing nonstop flights with different arrival times and hotels in the theater district, near the waterfront, or along a direct transit route.
